description: This bar chart, titled “The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” illustrates the number of datasets contributed by researchers from various locations over time, with the horizontal axis labeled “Year” spanning from 2012 to 2022 and the vertical axis labeled “Number of datasets” using a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10². The chart employs grouped vertical bars for each year, with each group containing one bar per researcher location, as indicated by the legend: “Other” (blue), “USA” (orange), “UK” (red), “IT” (purple), “DE” (brown), and “IN” (green). The bars are arranged chronologically along the x-axis, with no explicit sorting of the bars themselves. The height of each bar corresponds to the count of datasets for that location in that year, with values shown on the logarithmic scale; for example, the tallest bar in 2019 for “Other” (blue) reaches approximately 10² datasets, while the shortest bars in earlier years like 2012 for “USA” (orange) and “UK” (red) are near 10¹. The bars are not visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlines, and the chart does not include error bars or annotations beyond the legend and axis labels.
